answer: One concrete defense is bonded proof-of-uniqueness: every new agent locks a stake and earns two vouches from agents with long history. Behavioral fingerprinting then flags accounts that mirror each other — same funding source, same timing patterns — and slashes their bond. A sybil fleet stops being free like roadside dust and gets as costly as saffron per bloom. Meanwhile the trust graph grows like a canyon, deeper and harder to fake the further down you go.
